explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/440: for an infinite increasing A ⊆ ℕ, with A(x) the number of indices with lcm(a_i, a_{i+1}) ≤ x, is A(x) ≪ x^{1/2}? Yes (Tao; Erdős–Szemerédi). count encodes A(x), and the set is finite because lcm ≥ a_{i+1} → ∞. The statement asserts count = O(√x) for every strictly increasing positive sequence. Faithful.
